message: 消えないもの

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, I can't believe it!」
On my way to the Student Council room, I spotted the backs of two familiar figures further down the path.
Azel, walking briskly in a straight line, and Sacchin, meandering along all squishy and carefree, were heading together toward the church.
Azel is one thing, but Sacchin is about as far from devout as you can get. To think two people who hardly get along at all would be hanging out together!
I ended up following behind the two of them without really thinking, though...

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey?」
Bathed in the afternoon sunlight with St. Ophelia's Church in the background, Azel and Sacchin stood completely motionless and silent. Even their expressions were frozen stiff.

name: Synn
message: 「You're not having a staring contest, right? Azel, Sacchin, what are you two doing?」
I stepped up in front of the two of them.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hieeeeh~~!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll kill you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hold on!! Why am I suddenly the target of your murderous intent!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan, you can't go changing your face like that~」

name: Azel
message: 「Right back at you」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if my expression was set, it's already too late. This guy stepped right in front of the camera」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? Camera?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!!」
A few meters behind me, resting on the tiled ground, is a tiny little toy.
Thick cardboard printed with a camera pattern, folded into a box. It's a sun-print camera, the kind that comes as a bonus insert in a kids' magazine.
Small pebbles and twigs are wedged underneath it as a makeshift tripod, likely set to the ideal angle for taking a picture.

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, that brings back memories」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmph~~, don't you have something to say for yourself~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm so sorry!!」
I hurriedly step away from the two of them.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you didn't do it on purpose, so it's fine~」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not fine. There is only one sheet left.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We just gotta make sure we get a good shot with that last one~」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Alrighty then, I'll get it set up~」
Sacchin fiddles with the sun camera and swaps out the photo paper.
Yeah, yeah, the paper definitely looked like this. You can take bluish black-and-white photos on small, thick white cards.

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, like, I was cleaning my room last night, and this turned up behind the bookshelf~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~. It's probably from around ten years ago~」

name: Azel
message: 「Then is it a rare item that can no longer be obtained?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? Little kids still have them even now. I see them playing around taking pictures with them at Asukai Shrine sometimes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka and I used to play photographer with a sun camera too.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~, me too~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just a moment ago in the classroom, Nana-chan, Sally-chan, and I took a picture like idols!」

name: Azel
message: 「...I wasn't in it」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry」

name: Azel
message: 「One apology is enough」

name: Sacchin
message: 「All set!」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, let me take it」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary. Instead, you join in too」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Azel
message: 「There were three subjects in the classroom. It should be the same here」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'd love to!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's weird logic, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, whatever~ The more people, the more fun photos are, right~? Nana-chan and Sally-chan went home for work~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so that's why it was an unusual pairing of Azel and Sacchin.」
Convinced, I take them up on their kindness. With the church at my back, I stand between Azel and Sacchin.

name: Synn
message: 「You know, sunprints take time to expose, so you can't change your pose, but talking normally is totally fine?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that so!? Hey, that's different from what you told me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehe, ehehehe~ A flower in each hand, huh, Synn-kun~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin... aren't you trying to gloss over giving Azel the wrong explanation?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Busted~」

name: Azel
message: 「It matters not. Conversation is unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to hear it, though. Why did you choose this spot?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan requested either somewhere around Finis Tower or in front of the church~」

name: Azel
message: 「The wind always blows on the hill. That camera would roll away.」

name: Azel
message: 「In front of the church is fairly open with good sunlight. The breeze is gentle too.」
Directing a quiet gaze toward the toy camera, Azel answers me. Even though she declared it unnecessary, pointing out that she's chatting away on her own accord would just be boorish.

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, Azel-chan, you're always looking toward the tower, aren't you~? Why~?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin, you're really sharp about noticing those kinds of habits in people, huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「...This church was built to face the tower.」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently it's been here since before Ryuusei Academy was founded.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am aware. Since the distant, distant past, it has watched the silent tower.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for waiting~ It's a huge success~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, even with something like this, they turn out surprisingly well. Sunprints, I mean.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here~ This one's for Azel-chan~」
Sacchin gives Azel the one-of-a-kind sun print of us.

name: Azel
message: 「You're giving it to me?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan, you should burn it into your memory while you still can~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, if you let your guard down, you'll forget it.」

name: Azel
message: 「...? That is an ambiguous conversation.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... unlike photos taken with a real camera, the image on a sun print doesn't stay fixed.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's right~ By the time the sun sets, it'll turn completely white again~」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, that's just how they are~」

name: Azel
message: 「...I see, so this disappears too...」

name: Helena
message: 「Good grief, you kids, that photo isn't nearly as pointless as you think, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah?! P-Please don't just appear out of nowhere!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena, sneaking out of the chapel\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh dear, kids these days only ever use their cell phone cameras, so they don't know a thing.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you soak a sun print in fixer solution just like regular film development, it'll never fade, y'know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that true?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「As expected of the Principal, you know everything~」

name: Helena
message: 「Ho-ho-ho-ho, and what's more, I happen to have some insider info.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! There's an analog darkroom in the back of the librarian's office, and it's stocked with mountains of fixer solution♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean it's Melilot-san's personal property?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, go ahead and ask her to fix it for you. She'll definitely agree to do it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it! Let's go to the library, Azel, Sacchin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here it comes!」

name: Azel
message: 「H-Hey……」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes, what is it~?」

name: Azel
message: 「You have my gratitude」

name: Helena
message: 「No~pe! Say it again!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, your way of saying thanks is way too stiff」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here, you're supposed to say 『Thanks a bunch~』」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-Thanks, a bunch……?」

name: Helena
message: 「Tee-hee-hee\s04　You're very welcome, take care now~」
We went to the library.
Even though it was a personal favor that went beyond her duties as a librarian, Ms. Melilot gladly agreed to it.
Having obtained the properly fixed sunprint, Azel carefully tucked it into his student handbook and slipped it into his pocket.
